## Biographical Information

(1819-1899)

Cousin of CMY

CMY’s grandfather, the Rev. Duke Yonge, Vicar of Cornwood, had a sister who married into the Archer family, so they were relations. He was a brother of [Fulbert Archer](person_51.qmd) and of the Rev. Samuel Harward Archer. [LG 1952 Archer of Trelaske]
